_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. Nothing here is required — with no config.json at all you get a working board with the optional parts switched off. config.json is gitignored.

labels._comment: Optional. Which piece of work a session is about. Off entirely until 'root' or 'command' is set. index: 'folders' reads the list from disk, 'command' from any program printing JSON, 'none' switches it off outright.
labels._depth: 1 → <root>/<label>. 2 → <root>/<group>/<label>, where only the leaf is the label.
labels._pattern: Optional regex the folder name must match, so an 'Admin' folder in the tree doesn't become a label.
labels._noun: What to call one in the UI: label, project, client, matter, account…
labels._stoplist: Words that must never be read as a label name — your subagents, your own name.

timeLog._comment: Optional. A program printing hours already recorded somewhere else, so the Time tab can subtract them. See examples/.

calendars._comment: Optional. Calendars whose events may name a label. Empty means events still show, but are never attributed on their own.

reports._comment: Optional. A folder of pre-generated HTML reports to show in the panel. Leave dir null to hide the tab.
reports.label: Reports
reports._runCommand: Optional. A slash command that writes the report, e.g. "/morningbrief". Adds a Run button to the tab.
